{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CcyxQZWa8u6znfA1yHLKY","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01X3aNS2sJhAurQMBFVsRepu","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 -c \"\nimport pandas as pd\nimport numpy as np\npd.set_option('display.width', 200)\nc = pd.read_csv('companies.csv')\ni = pd.read_csv('invoices.csv')\n\ndef leading_digit(x):\n    x = abs(x)\n    if x == 0:\n        return None\n    while x < 1:\n        x *= 10\n    while x >= 10:\n        x /= 10\n    return int(x)\n\ni['lead'] = i.net_amount.apply(leading_digit)\n\nbenford = {d: np.log10(1+1/d) for d in range(1,10)}\n\ncounts = i.groupby('seller_id').size()\nactive_sellers = counts[counts>=5].index\nprint('num active sellers (>=5 invoices):', len(active_sellers))\n\nrows = []\nfor sid in active_sellers:\n    sub = i[i.seller_id==sid]\n    n = len(sub)\n    obs = sub.lead.value_counts()\n    chi2 = 0\n    for d in range(1,10):\n        expected = benford[d]*n\n        observed = obs.get(d,0)\n        chi2 += (observed-expected)**2/expected\n    rows.append((sid, n, chi2))\n\ndf = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['seller_id','n','chi2']).sort_values('chi2', ascending=False)\nprint(df.head(30).to_string())\n\"\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1117,"cache_read_input_tokens":37551,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1117,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"38f975f7-da65-4a15-8674-c7c784acbec6","uuid":"402c0c41-93ef-4623-ba3c-d34ffa5e083a","request_id":"req_011CcyxQYgxZyqLNXz2tbKaR"}
